job.job_description:
Key Responsibilities

- Take ownership of architecture design and development of scalable, distributed software systems, ensuring high performance and reliability.
- Translate complex business requirements into technical specifications to guide development efforts.
- Lead technical execution, ensuring code quality, adherence to deadlines, and efficient resource allocation across projects.
- Design, develop, and deploy LLM-based pipelines using patterns like RAG and Agentic workflows, optimizing for performance and scalability.
- Oversee the complete software development lifecycle, from requirements analysis to deployment, ensuring robust and efficient solutions.
- Utilize cloud services from AWS, Azure, or GCP, including IAM, Monitoring, Load Balancing, and Autoscaling, to enhance system capabilities.
- Implement and uphold DevOps practices using tools like Docker and Kubernetes to facilitate continuous integration and delivery.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams, conduct code reviews, and provide mentorship on software design and engineering best practices.

Overview

- As a Senior AI/LLM Engineer at our consulting firm in Bangalore, you will be at the forefront of developing advanced AI solutions, specializing in language model technologies.
- You will leverage your expertise in AI and machine learning to design and implement scalable and efficient software architectures.
- Your role will not only involve technical execution but also strategic decision-making to drive product goals with data-driven insights.
- You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to innovate and refine AI solutions that meet the complex needs of our clients.
- This position requires a seasoned engineer with over 5 years of software development experience, including a focus on language model solutions.
- As part of a dynamic consulting team, you will utilize cutting-edge tools and platforms to enhance product reliability and performance.
- Your contributions will directly impact the evolution of our AI capabilities, making advanced technologies accessible and valuable to our clients.
- The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of both traditional and modern machine learning techniques, with a strong proficiency in Python and cloud technologies such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
- Your ability to lead architectural designs and ensure the quality and efficiency of technical solutions will be crucial in delivering superior consulting services.
- You will also be responsible for implementing DevOps practices to streamline integration and delivery processes, ensuring that our software solutions are robust, scalable, and secure.
- This role offers the opportunity to work in a hybrid environment, providing flexibility while maintaining the high standards expected in the consulting sector.

Requirements

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent work experience in a related field.
- A minimum of 5 years of experience in software development, with significant experience in LLM application development.
- Strong proficiency in Python and JavaScript, with experience in API frameworks such as FastAPI and Django.
- Deep experience in cloud platforms, especially AWS, Azure, or GCP, and familiarity with their services.
- Proven experience with LLM patterns including RAG, Vector DB, and agent development, and tools like Langchain and DSPy.
- Hands-on experience with DevOps tools including Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS services such as Redshift and RDS.
- Demonstrated experience in deploying scalable applications in production environments, with a focus on security and compliance.
